items.name: parentheses_iterator
items.signature: fn parentheses_iterator<'a>(expr: ExprRef<'a>, parent: Option<AnyNodeRef<'_>>, tokens: &'a super::Tokens) -> impl Iterator<Item = ruff_text_size::TextRange> + 'a
items.summary: Returns an iterator over the ranges of the optional parentheses surrounding an expression.

items.name: parenthesized_range
items.signature: fn parenthesized_range(expr: ExprRef<'_>, parent: AnyNodeRef<'_>, tokens: &super::Tokens) -> Option<ruff_text_size::TextRange>
items.summary: Returns the [`TextRange`] of a given expression including parentheses, if the expression is parenthesized; or `None`, if the expression is not parenthesized.
